rca of the issue: PRE-FIX RCA (confirmed solved by main agent): (1) agent-chat-stream had `is_platform_owner` bypass that skipped the credit check for owner/admin roles, letting them generate freely. (2) Credit deduction (charge_user) only ran when (tokens_in + tokens_out) > 0; LLM providers occasionally returned zero token counts, so deduction was skipped entirely. FIX VERIFIED: (a) role bypass removed — owner@zerax.com with credits=10 now gets 402 on agent-chat-stream + chat + video-chat + producer-chat + games-chat (8/8 endpoints assert 402 with structured detail). (b) MIN_TURN_CHARGE_TOKENS floor of 1500 ensures credits always deduct — observed video-studio /chat reducing balance 10000 -> 9981 on a single turn. Sidebar phases fix verified visually: APP mode shows تدفق الشاشات / هوية التطبيق / بناء الشاشات / محاكي الجوال instead of website phases.
